episodes.title: Invitation
episodes.summary: In the mid-11th century, noblemen Harold of Wessex and William of Normandy are exploited as pawns in royal plots on both side of the Channel. The coronation of King Edward in England leads to the pair's first encounter, while Harold warns his father, Earl Godwin, of a rival's treachery – but he is ignored.

episodes.title: The Sins of the Father
episodes.summary: Threatened by those in power in France and England, William and Harold each face grave danger, their families in peril. Refuge in Flanders offers hope for new mother Matilda, while vengeful Lady Emma hounds the Godwins.

episodes.title: Brothers
episodes.summary: Harold risks returning to Wessex for his wife, while William plots against Henry in France as home truths compromise family ties.

episodes.title: So Be It
episodes.summary: Crowned heads are endangered as Harold fights for his family's rights and William tracks his royal foe.

episodes.title: The Beast in the Mirror
episodes.summary: Harold and Edith risk their lives to bargain with William but get a guarded reception. Harold's siblings face hardships trying to secure their family's future.

episodes.title: Damage
episodes.summary: Ambition drives William and Harold to each seek costly alliances, against the advice of their womenfolk, to enhance their chances of winning the crown.

episodes.title: Cost of War
episodes.summary: Sacrifices have to be made when Harold strikes against a Viking invader and William seeks a fleet. Edith fears for the future, while Matilda moves to secure hers.

episodes.title: The Hand of God
episodes.summary: Harold's depleted English forces rush to meet William's assault on the south coast. The resulting brutal battle's outcome is unpredictable.
